title: Utils++
description: Useful commands for Minecraft 1.20.1-1.20.2: instant gamemode switching, night vision, blindness, and a secret cat command — with language support (EN/RU).
body:
# Utils++

**Utils++** is a simple but useful mod with a set of commands for Minecraft 1.20.1 (Forge).

No more complex command block setups — just install and use.

---

## 🚀 Commands

| Command | What it does |
|---------|---------------|
| `/gm <0-3>` | Instant game mode change: 0 — Survival, 1 — Creative, 2 — Adventure, 3 — Spectator|
| `/nv` | Night vision for 14 hours (until you log off or drink milk) |
| `/vn` | Blindness for 10 seconds (useful for challenges or pranks) |
| `/mew`| Secret cat command 🐱 — meow in chat! |
| `/lang <en/ru>` | Switch message language between English and Russian |

---

## 🌍 Localization

All messages are in **English** by default.

To switch to Russian, just type:

/lang ru

To switch back to English:

/lang en


Typing `/lang` without arguments shows your current language. Your language preference is saved per player.

---

## 🎯 Why use this mod

- **All in one place** — no need to remember long effect commands
- **Instant game mode switching** — no menus, no delays
- **Lightweight** — the mod is tiny and won't affect performance

---

## 📦 Installation

1. Download the `.jar` file
2. Move it to your `.minecraft/mods` folder
3. Launch the game with **Forge 1.20.1-1.20.2**

---

## 🔧 Requirements

- Minecraft **1.20.1**
- **Forge** 47.4.10 or newer
